description: Main source file for a Flutter-based note-taking application which includes theme management, database interaction, notes management, and UI components for displaying, editing, and deleting notes.

classes.name: AppPalette
classes.description: Defines a monochrome color palette used across themes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Model class representing a note with properties and serialization methods.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class handling CRUD operations and search for notes.

classes.name: NoteDatabase
classes.description: Database layer class managing SQLite operations for notes.

classes.name: NotesApp
classes.description: Root widget managing theme mode and containing the app's main structure.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main screen displaying list of notes, search, theme toggle, and adding new notes.

classes.name: NoteDetailScreen
classes.description: Screen showing detailed view of a selected note with options to edit and delete.

classes.name: NoteEditModal
classes.description: Modal dialog for creating a new note or editing an existing one.

classes.name: _ConfirmDeleteDialog
classes.description: Dialog asking user to confirm deletion of a note.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initial entry point initializing Flutter and setting up the app with provider.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the current search query for filtering notes.

methods.name: filteredNotes
methods.description: Returns the list of notes filtered by the current search query.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens or creates the notes database.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the database.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database.
